subject: general
question: Which of the following is an earth-observation satellite to be launched jointly by NASA and ISRO?
solution:
The correct answer is __**NISAR.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **NISAR** is a joint** Earth-observing mission** between** NASA and ISRO **with the goal to make** global measurements of the causes and consequences of land surface changes using advanced radar imaging.**
 
• This mission concept and the resulting partnership are in response to the **National Academy of Science's 2007 survey of Earth observational priorities for the next decade, known as the decadal survey.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• ** NASA**

 
 
• It stands for** National Aeronautics and Space Administration.**
 
• It is founded on **29 July 1958**.
 
• It is an independent agency of the U.S. federal government responsible for the** civil space program, aeronautics research, and space research.**
 
 
 
• **ISRO**
 
 
• It stands for** Indian Space Research Organisation.**
 
• It is founded on** 15 August 1969.**
 
• It operates under the** Department of Space which is directly overseen by the PM of India.**
